messages:
Alex (CSM): Hey team — kicking off Triton onboarding. Quick sync on stakeholders, success criteria, and any obvious renewal risks. I put a basic timeline below. Please react with :thumbsup: if that works or drop blockers here.

Maria (Enablement): Thanks Alex. Can you confirm who will own daily enablement calls? I can run the first three if needed.

Alex (CSM): @Maria that would be great. If you can run day 1/3/7 check-ins (30m), I'll own the weekly tech/usage touchpoints.

Jamie (Solutions): FYI, engineering wants a copy of their schema and sample payloads by EOD Wed. Also need to know which model variants they'll start with for dev vs staging.

Priya (Account Exec): Renewal signal: customer procurement cycle ends in ~11 months. Initial usage targets will be important for RFP. Let's flag any potential blockers early.

Alex (CSM): Noted. High-level success criteria proposed: 1) Integration complete (API + auth) in 14 days; 2) 80% of pilot queries return <500ms p90 in staging; 3) Two feature area playbooks authored and validated by CS and engineering; 4) stakeholder enablement completed for 10 power users. Thoughts?

Maria (Enablement): I like those. For playbooks can we add a feedback loop? Suggest short survey after each enablement session and a central doc for shared notes. I can set up a Google form + Confluence page.

Jamie (Solutions): Agree. Also, small ask: can we allow a day to test redwood.private config for the pilot? Devs prefer private preview for initial load tests.

Alex (CSM): Good call. I'll ask infra for a 72-hour private deployment slot during week 2.

OpsBot: deploy-bot: private-preview request submitted (ticket #RWF-837). ETA 48h.

Priya (Account Exec): On renewal risk — they flagged SSO and audit logs as mandatory. If those aren't ready, procurement could delay. Can we prioritize SSO integration and an audit log export in the initial scope?

Alex (CSM): We'll prioritize SSO on day 3. Audit logs: Ops, can you confirm retention/export options we can offer?

Jamie (Solutions): Audit logs export is available via support API; retention defaults to 90 days. We can scope a longer retention as an add-on.

Maria (Enablement): Next steps checklist I can own and publish: ``
- Day 0: Kickoff + stakeholder rollcall
- Day 1: Enablement session #1 (ops + product)
- Day 3: SSO setup + enablement #2
- Day 7: Usage review + pilot config adjustments
- Week 2: Private preview load test
- Week 3: Playbook finalization + stakeholder sign-off
``
I'll also attach a short survey after each session and capture results.

Alex (CSM): Perfect. Can everyone drop any absolute no-go dates or blackouts now?

Priya (Account Exec): Customer is on holiday week starting 3150060000 (approx Fri of week 2) — avoid heavy ops during that period.

Jamie (Solutions): No blackouts from eng, but prefer not to schedule load tests on 3150055000 (their release day).

Alex (CSM): OK noted. Maria — if you can publish the checklist + form by EOD today, I'll ping infra for the private preview and tag SRE.

Maria (Enablement): Will do. Draft link: https://confluence.redwood/t/triton-onboard-playbook (will update).

Alex (CSM): Awesome. Closing loop: Owners: Alex (CSM) — program lead, Maria — enablement lead, Jamie — integration/tech lead, Priya — procurement/renewal contact. I'll follow up with a brief agenda for the first 30m kickoff. Thanks all :tada:
